TaskDescription: Trial accuracy (correct / incorrect / to late) from the feedback code.

onset.Description: Stimulus onset in seconds from t0 (first Pulse 30).

duration.Description: Reaction time in seconds (stimulus onset to first button press).

accuracy.Description: Verdict reported by Presentation in the feedback event.

stimulus.Description: Filename of the house image presented on the street map (NOT the feedback image).

response_port.Description: Presentation port code of the first participant button press. 115 is the scanner trigger and is never used here.
